pages.title: File:Natura 2000 Day- Žemaitija National Park, Lithuania (Copernicus 2025-05-21).png

ObjectName.value: Natura 2000 Day- Žemaitija National Park, Lithuania (Copernicus 2025-05-21)

Categories.value: Natura 2000|Žemaitija National Park|Attribution Copernicus|2024 satellite pictures|Photos of Lithuania by Sentinel-2|Photographs taken on 2024-10-18|Copernicus files uploaded by OptimusPrimeBot

ImageDescription.value: 21 May is Natura 2000 Day, dedicated to celebrating the EU’s vast network of over 25,000 protected sites under the EU Habitats Directive and Birds Directive and to honouring the collective efforts contributing to the network’s success. This Copernicus Sentinel-2 image, acquired on 18 October 2024, shows Žemaitija National Park in Lithuania. Located in the northwestern part of the country, the park is part of the Natura 2000 network. It exemplifies the region's rich ecology, which is dominated by forested hills and dotted with glacial lakes, including the prominent Lake Plateliai. The park protects a range of birds and natural habitats, from broadleaf woodlands and raised bogs to the black stork and the lesser spotted eagle. Open data from Copernicus helps to monitor important ecosystems around the world, helping to ensure that their wildlife and unique environmental characteristics are well preserved.

Credit.value: Natura 2000 Day: Žemaitija National Park, Lithuania

Artist.value: European Union, Copernicus Sentinel-2 imagery
